title.ko: 연결어: although · despite · however · so that · in order to
title.en: Linking words: although · despite · however · so that · in order to

explain.ko: although는 뒤에 절(주어 + 동사)이, despite / in spite of는 뒤에 명사나 -ing가 옵니다. however, nevertheless, therefore, besides는 문장을 연결하는 부사이며 보통 앞에 마침표나 세미콜론, 뒤에 쉼표를 씁니다. 목적은 to부정사나 in order to + 동사원형, 또는 so that + 절(주로 can / could / would)로 말합니다. whereas는 두 가지를 대조할 때, because of는 뒤에 명사를 둡니다.
explain.en: Although is followed by a clause (subject + verb), while despite / in spite of is followed by a noun or an -ing form. However, nevertheless, therefore and besides are linking adverbs, usually with a full stop or semicolon before and a comma after. Express purpose with to + verb, in order to + verb, or so that + clause (often with can / could / would). Whereas contrasts two things, and because of is followed by a noun.

head: 연결어 / Word
뒤에 오는 것 / Followed by
예문 / Example
rows: Although it rained, we went out.
Despite the rain, we went out.
It was cold. However, we enjoyed it.
I left early so that I wouldn't be late.
The school closed because of the snow.

notes.ko: although와 but을 한 문장에 함께 쓰지 않습니다.
notes.en: Don't use although and but together in one sentence.

notes.ko: despite 뒤에는 절을 쓰지 않습니다: Despite the rain (not Despite it rained).
notes.en: Don't use a clause after despite: Despite the rain (not Despite it rained).

notes.ko: 목적을 부정할 때는 in order not to 또는 so that + wouldn't를 씁니다.
notes.en: For a negative purpose use in order not to or so that + wouldn't.

prompt.ko: 연결어를 써서 3문장으로 써 보세요: 양보(although / despite), 목적(in order to / so that), 대조(however / whereas).
prompt.en: Write 3 sentences with linking words: a contrast (although / despite), a purpose (in order to / so that), and a comparison (however / whereas).

task.model: Although I was tired, I went to the party. I arrived early in order to meet my friends. I'm quiet, whereas my brother is outgoing.

model_trans.ko: 피곤했지만 저는 파티에 갔어요. 친구들을 만나려고 일찍 도착했어요. 저는 조용한 반면 형은 외향적이에요.
model_trans.en: Although I was tired, I went to the party. I arrived early in order to meet my friends. I'm quiet, whereas my brother is outgoing.
